escape_underscores option escapes underscores in plain text

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"escape_underscores\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>The variable_name is defined.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
